label: Order
caption: DAVID YOST, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF OHIO V. CYNTHIA BROWN, ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the March 14, 2025 order of the United States District Court for the Southern District of Ohio, case No. 2:24-cv-1401, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, April 16, 2025, by 5 p.m. (EDT).
